name: proj-three-point-estimate
description: Builds a three-point estimate for a project, with PERT mean and spread per work package, the forgotten work listed, and a range with a confidence line for the whole project. Use for "run proj-three-point-estimate", "three point estimate", "PERT estimate", "leadership wants a date before we have estimated", "give me a range not a single date", "how confident are we in this date", "optimistic most likely pessimistic", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
